question: One of the following types of transport through membranes does NOT exist:

options.opa: Ion transport facilitated by ionophore (against electrochemical gradient).
options.opb: Facilitated diffusion (in favor of electrochemical gradient)
options.opd: Ionic channel (in favor of electrochemical gradient).
options.ope: Simple diffusion (in favor of concentration gradient).

analysis: All the options listed are valid types of transport through membranes based on established medical knowledge.
